name: Hat ko nia
summary: The Vietnam Tourism rural portal lists hạt cờ nia among weekend-market specialties, then describes hạt kơ nia as a food: about the size of an almond, a thin brown shell, and a white kernel. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Mang Den weekend market. The rural portal calls hạt kơ nia a Central Highlands specialty to eat at this market.
texture: The Vietnam Tourism rural portal compares the nut to an almond, with a thin brown shell and a white kernel.
taste: The rural portal calls the kernel béo ngậy and thơm, with a ngọt bùi taste.
howToEat: Peel the thin brown shell. The rural portal describes the white kernel.
The list spells it hạt cờ nia. The eating note spells it hạt kơ nia. Both stay.
A price is Check on arrival. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen meets on Saturday and Sunday. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal puts the pine-hill grounds on Hùng Vương in xã Măng Đen, Quảng Ngãi. Báo Kon Tum, on that portal, puts the same pine hill on Hùng Vương in thị trấn Măng Đen, Kon Plông, and another of its articles puts the market at Vườn thông by the district central square. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Hat ko nia in Mang Den
seoDescription: Hạt kơ nia, also written hạt cờ nia, is the nut the Vietnam Tourism rural portal tells you to eat at the Mang Den weekend market. A price is Check on arrival.
